title: Fun piece, but the print isn't completely clear.
text:
Fun piece, but the print isn't completely clear.. Love the sign, and it's our front-door sign of the year. The bow is a nice touch.

The print, unfortunately, isn't that clear. It looks like a slightly low-quality image was blown up and printed on. It's not terrible, but once you get close (as does everyone when they're about to enter) there's noticeable pixelation.
